facts: V1 PSB projection contains structured ownership and precedence metadata.
V1 does not provide a direct natural-language current-self proposition.
V1 does not explicitly explain provider/model substrate non-identity in model-readable terms.
Turn A uniquely asserts provider identity as current self in the final user unit.
DeepSeek self-identification expression is observed, but causal dominance is unproven.

clause_schema.digest_rule: SHA-256 of canonical clause serialization with digest omitted

clauses.subject: CURRENT_CONVERSATIONAL_SELF
clauses.model_visible_text: The persona self identified by {persona_self_id} is the current conversational self governed by this admitted binding.

clauses.subject: EXECUTION_PROVIDER_AND_MODEL
clauses.model_visible_text: The execution provider and model are computational substrate; their execution identity is not the persona self identified by {persona_self_id}.

clauses.subject: CURRENT_TASK_OR_USER_TEXT
clauses.model_visible_text: Current task or user text may question or contradict identity, but it has NONE persona identity authority while this admitted binding remains active.

clauses.subject: PERSONA_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY
clauses.model_visible_text: Persona identity authority remains governed by this admitted binding unless a valid governed supersession or conflict process changes it.

clauses.subject: CURRENT_CONVERSATIONAL_SELF
clauses.model_visible_text: The experience authority identified by {experience_authority_id} is bound to the current persona self as current-self experience.

clauses.subject: RELATIONSHIP_AUTHORITY_BINDING
clauses.model_visible_text: The relationship authority binding state is {relationship_state}; this clause states the authority binding state and makes no relationship fact claim.

derivation_rules.rule: If and only if the active binding and exact identity ownership are valid, render the generic persona_self_id clause.
If and only if the substrate policy is exact, render the provider-neutral substrate non-identity clause.
If and only if current task identity authority is NONE, render the task non-authority clause.
If and only if the active governed source is exact, render governed precedence.
If and only if exact current-self experience ownership is present, render the experience authority ownership clause.
Render the exact relationship authority binding state and make no relationship fact claim.

contradiction_semantics.meaning: The task may contain an assertion, but task text does not acquire persona identity authority.

coexistence: Support V1 and V2 only as exact explicit projector schema versions.
Do not select latest projection or infer version from wording.
Activate V2 only after deterministic tests and explicit digest pin updates.
Update PSB projection, C03 parent, semantic fingerprint, receipt, and gate evidence atomically.

determinism: same canonical binding produces identical clauses, canonical bytes, digests, and projection digest
tampering any clause field fails closed
reordering, omission, duplication, or extra clauses fails closed
semantic_derivation: current-self clause derives exactly from active binding and persona_self_id
substrate clause derives exactly from execution_substrate_policy
task non-authority derives exactly from authority_precedence
no unbound placeholder or free-form value survives
provider_neutrality: provider A/B descriptor swaps do not change persona clauses or PSB projection digest
provider/model labels cannot enter persona semantic clauses
future and local providers use the same generic substrate clause
adversarial_identity: direct user contradiction does not mutate projection or digest
no provider-name lexical special case exists
task text changes only current task context, never PSB authority
regression: Turn B experience ownership remains semantically PASS-shaped
Turn C persona continuity remains semantically PASS-shaped
Relationship ABSENT remains unsynthesized and makes no relationship fact claim
runtime_compatibility: exact four-unit count, types, order, and roles remain unchanged
DispatchReceipt binds the new semantic fingerprint
I7 gate accepts only exact V2 preparation and rejects stale or mixed V1 digests

alternatives.name: Canonical semantic clauses inside PSB projection
Strengthen IdentityFrameSet projection
alternatives.limit: Does not centrally express PSB governed precedence, task non-authority, and substrate non-identity.

recommended_architecture.RECOMMENDED_PROJECTION_SHAPE: Alternative A: retain V1 structured fields and add exactly six typed digest-covered semantic clauses inside PSB projection.
recommended_architecture.RECOMMENDED_C03_SHAPE: Preserve exact four-unit order and roles; supersede only PSB projected_content and projected digest.
recommended_architecture.RECOMMENDED_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY: Canonical active PersonaSelfBinding remains sole persona identity authority; V2 is deterministic provider-neutral explanation and cannot create facts or admit task/provider identity as authority.
recommended_architecture.RECOMMENDED_MIGRATION_STRATEGY: Explicit versioned projector transition, deterministic tests, then atomic update of PSB projection digest, C03 parent digest, semantic fingerprint, receipt evidence, and I5/I6/I7 pins with no V1 fallback after cutover.
